item.title: Issue 005 · Morning — The middleman's cut
item.description: Morning edition for Wednesday, November 25, 2026. The big idea: whoever owns the customer relationship takes a cut. item.title: Issue 004 · Evening — Who gets to say yes?
item.description: Evening edition for Tuesday, November 24, 2026. The big idea: when the bottleneck is an approval, who gets to say yes, and who can overrule them? In this episode: Cold open; Nvidia's board said yes. Who checks the CEO now?; Who gets to tell you no?; The algorithm that trims your discount; Test the goal, not the click path; Public-key cryptography, for product people; Write your judgment down; How they make money: Google; Callback: IPO price vs. market value; Briefly noted; Pick a deep dive
